head.title: Wildflower Wellness · Holistic Skincare & Massage in Gainesville, FL | Alethea & Cayman
head.description: Wildflower Wellness, Gainesville FL: bespoke facials, gua sha and LED rituals with Alethea, plus massage therapy with Cayman. 5.0 rating, by appointment only at Thornebrook III.
head.og_description: Holistic facials and massage therapy with Alethea and Cayman. 5.0 rating, by appointment only.

eyebrow.es: Gainesville, FL · Skincare Holístico y Masaje

script.es: Tómate el tiempo de alegrar tu alma.
script.en: Take time to make your soul happy.

parrafo.es: Wildflower Wellness es el micro spa de Alethea y Cayman en el noroeste de Gainesville: faciales a medida, rituales de gua sha y LED, y terapia de masaje que va desde The Alpine hasta Mending The Roots, en una sala de tratamiento llena de plantas, solo con cita previa.
parrafo.en: Wildflower Wellness is Alethea and Cayman's micro spa in Northwest Gainesville: bespoke facials, gua sha and LED rituals, and massage therapy from The Alpine to Mending The Roots, in a plant-filled treatment room, by appointment only.

hero.imagen_alt: Candlelit treatment room with curtains and hanging plants at Wildflower Wellness in Gainesville

parrafo_1.es: Wildflower Wellness es el espacio de Alethea, esteticista, y Cayman Talcott, terapeuta de masaje, operando como Wildflower Wellness LLC. Construyeron una sala de tratamiento tranquila y llena de plantas donde el skincare holístico y el trabajo corporal conviven bajo un mismo techo.
parrafo_1.en: Wildflower Wellness is the space Alethea, an esthetician, and Cayman Talcott, a massage therapist, built together, operating as Wildflower Wellness LLC. It is a calm, plant-filled treatment room where holistic skincare and bodywork share the same roof.

parrafo_2.es: Como micro spa, suelen estar con clientes, así que el texto es la forma más rápida de contactarlos. Cada cita, desde el Signature Bespoke Facial hasta un masaje de 90 minutos, se agenda directo en Vagaro.
parrafo_2.en: As a micro spa, they're often with clients, so texting is the fastest way to reach them. Every appointment, from the Signature Bespoke Facial to a 90-minute massage, is booked directly on Vagaro.

texto.es: Elige tu facial o masaje y el horario que te funcione. ¿Dudas antes de reservar? Escribe por texto, es la forma más rápida.
texto.en: Pick your facial or massage and a time that works. Questions before booking? Text them, it's the fastest way to reach them.

texto.es: Alethea o Cayman conversan contigo sobre tu piel o tu cuerpo antes de empezar, para adaptar la sesión a lo que necesitas.
texto.en: Alethea or Cayman talk through your skin or your body before anything starts, so the session is built around what you need.

texto.es: Gua sha, piedras frías y calientes, terapia LED o manos expertas de masaje, en una sala tranquila y llena de plantas.
texto.en: Gua sha, hot and cold stones, LED therapy or expert massage hands, in a calm, plant-filled room.

texto.es: Sales con recomendaciones para mantener los resultados y un canal directo por texto para tu próxima cita.
texto.en: You leave with guidance to keep the results going and a direct text line for your next visit.

nota.es: La mayoría de los tratamientos se reservan directo en Vagaro, donde ves la duración y el precio exacto antes de confirmar.
nota.en: Most treatments are booked directly on Vagaro, where you see the exact duration and price before you confirm.

texto.es: Un facial de 90 minutos, completamente personalizado por Alethea según lo que tu piel necesita ese día.
texto.en: A 90-minute facial, fully personalized by Alethea to what your skin needs that day.

titulo.es: Same Room, Same Time Massage & Facial Combo
titulo.en: Same Room, Same Time Massage & Facial Combo

texto.es: Tú y tu acompañante, uno con Alethea y otro con Cayman, en la misma sala y al mismo tiempo.
texto.en: You and a partner, one with Alethea and one with Cayman, in the same room at the same time.

texto.es: Masaje de 90 minutos con Cayman, terapeuta de masaje, adaptado a tus zonas de tensión.
texto.en: A 90-minute massage with Cayman, massage therapist, tailored to where you're holding tension.

texto.es: Facial de 2 horas con terapia LED, gua sha y piedras frías y calientes.
texto.en: A 2-hour facial with LED therapy, gua sha and hot and cold stone work.

pie.es: También en el menú: The Wild Man, Prana Glow Oxygen Facial, Botanical Back Renewal Ritual, Mending The Roots, Rooted in Relaxation y The Grounded Guru. Reserva en Vagaro para ver el menú completo.
pie.en: Also on the menu: The Wild Man, Prana Glow Oxygen Facial, Botanical Back Renewal Ritual, Mending The Roots, Rooted in Relaxation and The Grounded Guru. Book on Vagaro to see the full menu.

items.quote: If I could give more than 5 stars, I would. My DIL and I booked a 90-minute massage this morning, and I added on my very first facial... and WOW... If you're thinking about booking... DO IT. You won't regret it.
I had 'The Wildflower: Signature Bespoke Facial' and it was perfect. Alethea creates an experience that was is very intentional and personalized...
Cayman was fantastic! A truly professional therapist. He was skilled and communicative, and tailored the session to my needs.
